title: check_stack output
description: Every field is a record of what was observed. coverage and limits are present on every response, without exception.

checked_at.description: When this response was assembled. ISO 8601 UTC. Not the date the underlying observations were taken - those are on each price.

depth.description: The depth the response was answered at, echoed back.

groups.description: One entry per group into which two or more of the submitted endpoints were placed. A group is an agreement between responses. It is not a statement about the operators.

endpoint_ids.description: The submitted endpoint urls placed in this group. The url is the identifier.

confidence.description: Groups below moderate are never returned. They appear in unmatched with a reason.

unmatched.description: Submitted endpoints not placed in any returned group. This includes endpoints never observed, so read coverage before drawing a conclusion from it.

unmatched_reasons.description: Why each unmatched endpoint is unmatched. An absence of duplication and an absence of data are different results.

prices.description: The most recently recorded price for each submitted endpoint that has one. An endpoint absent from this list has no recorded price.

price_usd.description: Recorded price per call in USD, carried at the precision it was recorded at rather than rounded to two places, because prices below one cent are common.

multiple_vs_cheapest.description: This price divided by the cheapest price in the same returned group, to two decimal places. 1.00 for an endpoint in no returned group.

observed_at.description: When this price was observed. Present on every price, without exception.

cheapest_in_group.description: The cheapest recorded member of each returned group.

coverage.description: known counts the submitted endpoints that have been observed. unknown counts those that have not. Present on every response.

limits.description: What the method cannot see. The same four constraints on every response, every time.
